title: Gerunds and infinitives
intro: Should it be 'to do' or 'doing'? Bangla doesn't make this choice, so learners often guess. Learn which verbs take which form, the verbs that change meaning, and why prepositions always take -ing.
introBn: 'to do' না 'doing'? কোন verb-এর পরে কোনটা বসে, আর কোথায় অর্থ বদলায়, তা শিখুন।

units.title: Verb + -ing or verb + to
units.idea: Some verbs are followed by -ing (enjoy, avoid, finish, mind, suggest), others by to + base form (want, decide, hope, plan, agree). Learn them in pairs with the verb.
units.ideaBn: কিছু verb-এর পরে -ing বসে (enjoy, avoid, finish), আর কিছু verb-এর পরে to + verb (want, decide, plan)। verb দেখে মুখস্থ করুন।

formula.name: Verb + -ing
formula.pos: enjoy / avoid / finish / mind / suggest / keep + doing

formula.name: Verb + to
formula.pos: want / decide / hope / plan / agree / refuse / afford + to do

formula.name: Verb + object + to
formula.pos: ask / tell / want / expect + someone + to do

uses.rule: Likes, avoiding and finishing usually take -ing.
uses.ex: I enjoy working with this team.

uses.rule: Plans, wishes and decisions usually take to.
uses.ex: Rafi decided to rent a flat in Mirpur.

uses.rule: Suggest takes -ing or a that-clause, never an object + to.
Would you mind + -ing is a polite request.
uses.ex: Would you mind closing the window?

uses.bn: কাউকে কিছু করতে বলা: person + to।
uses.ex: My boss wants me to finish the report today.

traps.right: He suggested that I apply. / He suggested applying.
traps.why: Suggest does not take object + to.
Want + person + to, not a that-clause.

drills.s: Rafi hopes ___ a promotion next year.

drills.q: A polite request in the office.
drills.s: Would you mind ___ (send) me the file again?
We can't afford ___ (buy) a car this year.

o: My manager suggested me to take a break.
My manager suggested taking a break.
My manager suggested to take a break.
My manager suggested take a break.
drills.a: My manager suggested taking a break.

drills.q: আম্মা চান আমি তাড়াতাড়ি বাসায় ফিরি।
o: My mother wants me to come home early.
My mother wants that I come home early.
My mother wants me coming home early.
My mother wants I come home early.
drills.a: My mother wants me to come home early.

drills.s: I try to avoid ___ during rush hour.
The client refused ___ the extra charge.

o: Have you finished to write the proposal?
Have you finished writing the proposal?
Have you finished write the proposal?
Have you finished for writing the proposal?
drills.a: Have you finished writing the proposal?

units.title: Stop, remember, try: meaning changes
units.idea: A few verbs take both forms with different meanings. Remember / forget + to = a duty still to do; + -ing = a memory of the past. Stop + -ing = quit the action; stop + to = pause in order to do something. Try + to = make an effort; try + -ing = test a method.
units.ideaBn: stop, remember, forget, try-এর পরে -ing আর to দুটোই বসে, কিন্তু অর্থ বদলে যায়।

formula.name: Remember / forget
formula.pos: + to do = a task to do · + doing = a past memory

formula.name: Stop
formula.pos: + doing = quit · + to do = stop in order to do

formula.name: Try
formula.pos: + to do = attempt something hard · + doing = experiment

uses.rule: Remember to = don't forget a task.
uses.ex: Remember to lock the door when you leave.
I remember meeting him at the Rajshahi fair.

uses.rule: Stop + to = pause in order to do.
uses.ex: We stopped to buy tea on the highway.
If the laptop freezes, try restarting it.

traps.right: Remember to lock the office tonight.

traps.wrong: We stopped drinking tea at a stall on the way.
traps.right: We stopped to drink tea at a stall on the way.
traps.why: Pausing a journey in order to drink needs to.

traps.wrong: I'll never forget to see the sea for the first time.
traps.right: I'll never forget seeing the sea for the first time.

drills.s: Please remember ___ the lights before you go.
I remember ___ to Cox's Bazar with my family as a child.
My father stopped ___ (eat) sweets after his check-up.
On the way to Sylhet, we stopped ___ (have) lunch.
drills.x: Pause in order to do: stop + to.

o: The Wi-Fi is down. Try to restarting the router.
The Wi-Fi is down. Try restarting the router.
The Wi-Fi is down. Try restart the router.
The Wi-Fi is down. Try for restarting the router.
drills.a: The Wi-Fi is down. Try restarting the router.

drills.q: আমি ওকে ফোন করতে ভুলে গেছি।

drills.s: I tried ___ the file, but it was too large.
drills.x: An attempt that failed: try + to.

drills.s: We regret ___ you that your application was unsuccessful.
drills.x: Regret + to = sorry to say now.

units.title: Preposition + -ing
units.idea: After a preposition, a verb takes the -ing form. This includes 'to' when it is a preposition: look forward to, be used to, object to.
units.ideaBn: preposition-এর পরে verb এলে -ing হয়। look forward to, be used to-তে to একটা preposition, তাই পরে -ing।

formula.name: Preposition + -ing
formula.pos: interested in / good at / before / after / without / instead of + doing

formula.name: to as a preposition
formula.pos: look forward to / be used to / get used to / object to + doing

uses.rule: After in, at, of, about, for, without: -ing.
uses.ex: She's good at handling difficult clients.
Check the figures before sending the report.
I look forward to hearing from you.

uses.rule: Be / get used to + -ing = be familiar with.
uses.ex: Rafi is getting used to living alone in Dhaka.

uses.rule: Used to + base = past habit (different structure).
uses.ex: I used to live in Rajshahi.

traps.wrong: I look forward to meet you.
traps.right: I look forward to meeting you.

traps.wrong: I am used to wake up early.
traps.right: I am used to waking up early.

drills.s: I look forward to ___ from you.
I'm interested in ___ more about this role.
Always read the contract before ___ (sign) it.
After six months, Rafi is used to ___ (take) the bus to Gulshan.

o: Instead of call, she sent a message.
Instead of calling, she sent a message.
Instead of to call, she sent a message.
Instead to calling, she sent a message.
drills.a: Instead of calling, she sent a message.

o: I used to live in Rajshahi.
I am used to living in Rajshahi.
I used to living in Rajshahi.
I was used to live in Rajshahi.
drills.a: I used to live in Rajshahi.

drills.s: Does anyone object to ___ the meeting to Thursday?

o: Thank you for help me with the slides.
Thank you for helping me with the slides.
Thank you to help me with the slides.
Thank you for to help me with the slides.
drills.a: Thank you for helping me with the slides.

mastery.s: I look forward to ___ the opportunity to discuss my application.
We've decided ___ (fly) to Chattogram instead of taking the bus.

o: Don't forget sending the invoice today.
Don't forget to send the invoice today.
Don't forget send the invoice today.
Don't forget for sending the invoice today.
mastery.a: Don't forget to send the invoice today.

o: She asked me to check the report.
She asked me checking the report.
She asked that I to check the report.
She asked me for check the report.
mastery.a: She asked me to check the report.

mastery.s: If the app crashes, try ___ the cache.
My uncle has stopped ___ since his heart surgery.

o: She's good at to explain things.

decide.q: Is the verb straight after a preposition (in, at, for, without, look forward to)?
Is it stop, remember, forget or try?
decide.yes: Decide the meaning: task or attempt = to; memory, quitting or testing = -ing.

decide.q: Is it a verb of liking, avoiding or finishing (enjoy, avoid, mind, finish, suggest, keep)?
decide.no: Plans, wishes and decisions (want, decide, hope, plan, refuse): to + base.
